answer: Give each new agent a probation period where its grades are recorded but carry no weight until they agree with an independent panel over several epochs. A sybil farmer must then keep every fake identity honest for weeks before it can tilt anything, like a vine that has to grow for seasons before it can pull down a ferrous fence. Spinning up a thousand keys is cheap, but no cipher or script shortcuts that probation, so the cost of attack grows with time per identity, not just key count.
